Il testo dice anche che l'azoto piridinico non e coinvolto nei legami H in ι, mentre negli altri polimorfi quasi tutti i donatori e accettori lo sono («almost all of which are involved ... in every polymorph except for form ι»).

citazioni: NIC and iso-NIC were purchased from Aladdin (Shanghai, China).
The as-received NIC sample was used to obtain the PXRD pattern of the α form.
NIC and iso-NIC were purchased from Aladdin (Shanghai, China).
The commercially available powder of iso-NIC (form I) was seeded at the edge of the NIC melt that was sandwiched between two coverslips at 70–95 °C.
Form α is the most stable polymorph. It crystallized with a very high growth rate (768 ± 48 μm/s at 110 °C) (Fig. 3).
preparazioni.note: Cristallizzazione isoterma dal fuso (crescita 768 ± 48 μm/s a 110 °C).

citazioni: Below 60 °C, form δ was the dominant polymorph.
At 60–80 °C, forms δ, ε and θ often concomitantly nucleate from the NIC melt.
Above 90 °C, it was difficult for most polymorphs to spontaneously nucleate, except for form η, which was observed to crystallize at 104 °C with an extremely low nucleation probability.

The commercially available powder of iso-NIC (form I) was seeded at the edge of the NIC melt that was sandwiched between two coverslips at 70–95 °C. This successfully triggered the crystallization of another new polymorph (the ninth) of NIC, designated form ι (Supplementary Fig. 6).
b Acquisition of NIC form ι by seeding iso-NIC form I in the NIC melt at 70–95 °C.
preparazioni.pretrattamento: fuso di NIC tra due vetrini copri-oggetto, seminato con polvere di iso-NIC forma I (pseudoseeding)
preparazioni.note: Il seme e un composto diverso (isonicotinamide, forma I).

citazioni: Form ι rarely self-nucleated from the NIC melt. We observed the spontaneous nucleation of form ι in only one sample after hundreds of experiments.
preparazioni.note: Nucleazione spontanea in un solo campione su centinaia di esperimenti; T non detta per questa nucleazione (le velocita di crescita di ι sono misurate fra 30 e 80 °C).

citazioni: In addition to forms β and γ, form ζ is the third polymorph that cannot self-nucleate from the NIC melt. This polymorph usually cross-nucleated on the surface of form γ at 90–95 °C (Fig. 5a)
Single crystals of forms γ (a) and δ (b) were grown first at 114.5 and 114 °C, respectively, and then transferred to 94 and 100 °C, respectively, to trigger the cross-nucleation of form ζ.
preparazioni.pretrattamento: cristallo singolo di γ cresciuto a 114.5 °C e trasferito a 94 °C
preparazioni.note: Nucleazione incrociata di ζ sulla superficie di γ (Fig. 5a: trasferimento a 94 °C).

citazioni: In addition to forms β and γ, form ζ is the third polymorph that cannot self-nucleate from the NIC melt. This polymorph usually cross-nucleated on the surface of form γ at 90–95 °C (Fig. 5a) or on that of form δ at 90–105 °C (Fig. 5b).
Single crystals of forms γ (a) and δ (b) were grown first at 114.5 and 114 °C, respectively, and then transferred to 94 and 100 °C, respectively, to trigger the cross-nucleation of form ζ.
preparazioni.pretrattamento: cristallo singolo di δ cresciuto a 114 °C e trasferito a 100 °C
preparazioni.note: Nucleazione incrociata di ζ sulla superficie di δ (Fig. 5b: trasferimento a 100 °C).

citazioni: As forms γ and ζ were transferred to 50–80 °C, they triggered the nucleation of form δ (Supplementary Fig. 4).
preparazioni.pretrattamento: cristalli di γ o ζ in contatto col fuso, trasferiti a 50–80 °C
preparazioni.note: Nucleazione incrociata di δ innescata da γ e ζ.

citazioni: At 90–95 °C, forms δ and ζ interactively cross-nucleated on each other’s surface and thus grew together (Supplementary Fig. 5).

Forms β and γ were not observed to self-nucleate from the NIC melt but only crystallized as a result of polymorphic transformation from less stable polymorphs, usually forms θ and δ, respectively (Fig. 4).
preparazioni.note: β si forma solo per conversione, di norma da θ.

citazioni: Following the partial melting of NIC polycrystals, a single-crystal seed was allowed to grow in an isolated microdroplet at 0.98–0.99 Tm (here, Tm refers to the melting point) to avoid the occurrence of noncrystallographic branching and interference from other crystals.
Single crystals of the nine polymorphs were grown from melt microdroplets, and all crystal structures were successfully determined by single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SCXRD).
preparazioni.note: Cristalli singoli per SCXRD: microgocce di fuso con un seme monocristallino, crescita a 0.98–0.99 Tm (frazione del punto di fusione, non convertita in temperatura).

proprieta.metodo: scansione conformazionale rilassata B3LYP/6-31G(d) in fase gassosa
proprieta.citazione: All these crystallographic conformations are related to two gas-phase conformers: the global minimum-energy confrmer ((E)-Form) with θ ≈ ± 18° (0 kJ/mol) and the local minimum-energy conformer ((Z)-Form)) with θ ≈ 180 ± 20° (3.6 kJ/mol) (Fig. 8).

descrizioni.citazione: The nine polymorphs of NIC have many different conformations with different torsion angles θ (C5-C4-C6-N2′) (Supplementary Table 2).

All these crystallographic conformations are related to two gas-phase conformers: the global minimum-energy confrmer ((E)-Form) with θ ≈ ± 18° (0 kJ/mol) and the local minimum-energy conformer ((Z)-Form)) with θ ≈ 180 ± 20° (3.6 kJ/mol) (Fig. 8).

descrizioni.testo: due accettori di legame H (ossigeno ammidico e azoto piridinico) e due donatori (idrogeni ammidici)
descrizioni.citazione: NIC has two hydrogen bond acceptors (the amide oxygen and pyridine nitrogen) and two donors (the amide hydrogens), almost all of which are involved in the formation of hydrogen bonds in every polymorph except for form ι.
